name: se2
description: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature Plan, Implement, and live session Audit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan clear Feature Plans and implement them through verified workers.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first plugin with explicit durable-context, Idea capture, textual Feature Plan creation, GitHub-Feature-to-PR implementation, and live session Audit entry points. Learn performs only authorized local-repository context changes and has no external dependency preflight. Idea publishes hosted Ideas by default through G, with local preview as an opt-in. Feature analyzes one or more source issues, uses optional bounded read-only analysts and an independent critic when delegation is available, presents one consolidated batch of material questions, converges repository-owned textual Feature Plans with stable Feature acceptance criteria, and publishes the plan by default without deriving implementation units. Idea, Feature, and Implement share one portable-content safety gate immediately before every hosted write; SE2 owns semantic projection while G owns transport and readback. Implement consumes authoritative Feature Plans, derives execution units in its control plane, coordinates a Sol/medium orchestrator with one adaptive Sol Feature Worker, isolated worktree, branch, and PR per implementation-eligible plan member, and binds plan criteria to one final exact HEAD. Parallelism and standalone or stacked delivery topology exist only across plan members, while product-level contradictions return to the user rather than relaunching Feature planning automatically. Implement consumes exact-head provider readiness from G's delivery-status workflow, maps Git and GitHub transport to G-owned workflows, gates stacked children on a green exact-HEAD parent, reconciles parent drift, and keeps a minimal SQLite WAL recovery ledger. Provider automation and bypass capabilities never authorize Implement to merge, enqueue, or change auto-merge state. An explicit SE2 GitHub request implicitly authorizes the exact in-scope hosted writes required by its selected workflow; merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure remain outside the default scope. Audit observes active SE2 sessions read-only, reconstructs workflow-graph conformance from positive evidence, and reports feedback, bugs, regressions, graph violations, and graph-design improvements without persistent state. Root contracts standardize graph vocabulary, live task preflight, optional delegation and goal capability observations, destination and identity observation, bounded display-title reconciliation, update relay, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:learn for durable repository knowledge or $se2:idea for transient capture and explicit GitHub publication.

Use $se2:feature for an explicit textual Feature Plan run with optional read-only analysts, an independent critic, and one consolidated question batch; publish by default without deriving implementation units.
Use $se2:implement to interpret authoritative Feature Plans, create an orchestrator and Feature Workers, and return verified PR delivery, or use $se2:audit to monitor SE2 graph runs read-only.
